icloud.unavailable: iCloud is unavailable. Check your connection and refresh.
icloud.name: Filename

errors.boundary: Cannot access this location. Choose another folder.
errors.download: File not ready. Try again shortly.
errors.invalid: Invalid selection. Choose songs or a playlist again.
errors.tooMany: Too many files. Use a smaller folder or copy fewer songs.
errors.space: Not enough disk space. Free some space and retry.
errors.permission: Cannot access this file. Check permissions.
errors.timeout: Timed out. Check your connection and retry.
errors.playback: Cannot play. Try copying to a local playlist.
errors.downloadFailed: Download failed. Check your connection and retry.
errors.nativeUnavailable: Download component unavailable. Reinstall the app.
errors.uploading: Still syncing to iCloud. Try again shortly.
errors.notUploaded: Not in iCloud yet, so the download stays.
errors.pinned: Kept downloaded. Turn that off in Finder first.
errors.playing: This song is playing. Stop it first.
errors.notCloud: This file is not in iCloud.

icloud.metadataWarning: Playlist info was not updated. Rescan the playlist.
icloud.cancelHint: Stops waiting; the system download may continue.
icloud.folderNotLocal: Folder not ready. Try again shortly.
icloud.driveProjectionHint: Some app folders are not supported
icloud.confirmRemove: This moves the iCloud original to the Recycle Bin. Other devices lose it too.
icloud.confirmMove: This moves the original out of iCloud. Other devices lose it too.
icloud.confirmRewrite: Saving rewrites the iCloud original and syncs it to other devices.
icloud.confirmNewFile: The new file is saved in the iCloud folder and uploaded. The original stays.
icloud.confirmReplace: This replaces the iCloud original and syncs it. The old file goes to the Recycle Bin.
